packageRules.description: We choose the Node version by hand, so turn off version bumps for these two images. 'digest' is deliberately not in the list above: rebuilds of the tag we already use still come through, otherwise pinning by digest would freeze us on an unpatched base image forever.

A digest update is upstream rebuilding a tag we already trust, usually to ship OS security patches. The 14-day wait above guards against compromised package releases, which does not apply here and would only delay the patches we pin for.
